speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Well you can't stay with me, I have a teeny tiny apartment.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Excuse me, but isn't hosting guests an aspect of Menushya Yajna, one of the five central religious duties or sacrifices of the Hindu householder?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Don't be ridiculous, you love trains.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Yes I do, come on. See you later Leonard.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: This is a very old building.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Sixty years. Used to be a watch factory. What?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Don't you worry about the residual radium from the luminous dials?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I can't believe I didn't bring my gieger counter. You know, I had it on my bed and I didn't pack it.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Well, if you're not comfortable staying here, Sheldon...

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm kidding, I packed it. It was a joke, I was subverting the conversational expectations. I believe they call that the, um, old switcheroo.
